main_text.p: grediantur in cœlestem Jerufalem, quam Apostolus Gal. 4. v. 26. appellat matrem omnium nostrûm. Ita B. Theodoretus.

p.i: Sponsâ præ nimio gaudio de inventione & fruitione sponsi omni studio quæsiti in extasim incidente dicit Sponsus :

main_text.p: 5. ADjuro vos filiæ Jerufalem per capreas cervosque camporum ne suscitetis, neque evigilare faciatis dilectam, donec ipsa velit.
main_text.head: EXPLICATIO.
main_text.p: DE sensu hujus versiculi vide quæ diximus supra cap. 2. vers. 7.
6. QUæ est ista, quæ ascendit per defertum sicut virgula fumi ex aromatibus myrrhæ, & thuris, & universi pulveris pigmentarii ?
7. En lectulum Salomonis sexaginta fortes ambiunt ex fortissimis Israël :
8. Omnes tenentes gladios, & ad bella doctissimi : uniuscujusque ensis super femur suum propter timores nocturnos.
9. Ferculum fecit sibi Rex Salomon de lignis Libani :
10. Columnas ejus fecit argenteas, reclinatorium aureum, ascensum purpureum : media charitate confstravit propter filias Jerufalem.
11. Egredimini & videte filiæ Sion Regem Salomonem in diademate, quo coronavit illum mater sua in die desponsationis illius, & in die lætitiæ cordis ejus.

page.notes: Left edge strip is a fragment of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The running-head and the sentence "EXPLI-" at the foot are read as printed; the final word is a catchword broken across the page. Some letters in the Latin are uncertain due to the scan's quality (e.g. "vcilt"/"velit", "confstravit" for "constravit").
